page_title: Create a Collaborative Rich Text Editing Experience with Flutter Web and Appwrite

summary.title: Create a Collaborative Rich Text Editing Experience with Flutter Web and Appwrite
summary.one_liner: A video walkthrough of building a Google Docs-style collaborative rich-text editor in Flutter Web backed by Appwrite, covering setup through real-time document editing.
keywords: how to build collaborative text editor
takeaways: Set up a Flutter Web project with Riverpod for state management and Routemaster for routing.
Configure Appwrite as an open-source Firebase alternative for authentication and data storage.
Build login and registration pages and protect logged-in routes.
Create, update, save, and list documents, and propagate changes in real time between users.
summary.summary: This is a roughly two-hour YouTube video from the channel Fun with Flutter, published April 2022, that walks through building a collaborative rich-text editing app. The chapter list shows the build order: base setup, Riverpod and Routemaster configuration, Appwrite setup, an authentication repository and state service, login and registration pages, logged-in routes, document UI and state, creating and saving documents, real-time changes, and opening and listing documents. The page text includes only the chapter list and sidebar, so the details of the implementation are not visible here. It is listed under Flutter in a project-based learning collection as a Google Docs clone.
